elephant-birds-vanish-madagascar.description: A large dark-feathered flightless bird with a long neck and thick legs stands in a dry scrubland with baobab trees in the background. A cream-colored egg sits in a nest of twigs at right, and a small distant human figure stands among the trees at right edge. Painted in a dark, moody palette with warm light on the ground. No visible text or frame.

moa-extinct-new-zealand.description: A large brown flightless bird with a long neck and small head stands in a misty forest of moss-hung trees and ferns, sunbeams falling through the haze. Two dark-skinned figures in grass capes crouch at the lower left, holding spears. No text, border or frame is visible, and the painting fills the square edge to edge.

stellers-sea-cow-hunted-out.description: A huge grey sea animal with a small head and a fluked tail lies in dark kelp in cold, choppy water. Behind it, a small wooden boat with four men in tricorn hats and period coats rows toward it, with snowy mountains in the misty background. No text, no frame, nothing graphic.

last-great-auks-killed.description: A painted seascape of a stormy sea with dark cliffs. A wooden rowboat carries about four or five men in dark oilskins and caps, and one man in front reaches toward two upright black-and-white seabirds on a seaweed-covered rock beside a large speckled egg. There is no visible text, signature or frame, and no blood or violence.

last-cape-lion-shot.description: A large maned lion with a dark mane stands on a dark rocky outcrop, gazing left. Foreground has flowering protea-like shrubs. In the distance, a white-topped ox wagon and two mounted riders, one holding a long rifle, move across rolling dusky hills under a dramatic cloudy sky. Oil-painting style, filling the frame edge to edge. A tiny mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

tasmanian-emu-extinct.description: A large dark-plumed emu with a pale blue-grey throat stalks across dry, tussocky grassland at dusk under a dramatic amber-lit sky. Distant mountains sit on the horizon, and on the right a small wooden hut with a smoking chimney stands behind a split-rail fence. Foreground has scrubby bushes and rocky, churned earth. The painting is loose, dark and painterly, with no visible text, border or signature.

stephens-island-wren-extinct.description: A dark, painterly night scene on a rocky clifftop covered in tussock grass. A white lighthouse with a glowing lamp beam stands at the top, and the sea is at right. A striped tabby cat crouches low in the grass at left, watching down toward a small, round, nearly tailless olive-green songbird picking across lichen-covered rocks in the foreground. No text, no frame.

rocky-mountain-locust-extinct.description: A large brown-gold locust sits on a wheat stalk in the foreground. Behind it, a flat dark prairie stretches under a stormy, cloud-filled sky, with a small weathered wooden cabin on the horizon. The style is an oil painting with warm, muted tones and no visible text.

huia-last-seen.description: Two glossy dark blue-black birds with long, curved pale bills and orange wattles perch on a moss-covered branch in a dense fern forest. Their long tails have white tips, and one bird's bill is open. Soft light falls through the trees, and the painting is edge to edge with no visible text or frame.

last-carolina-parakeet-dies.description: A single green parrot with a yellow-orange head perches on a gnarled bare branch in a dim, glass-roofed aviary of iron bars. Other perches are bare, and more cages with bare branches sit at the left and right edges. Through the back grille there is a dark ornate iron structure with snow-like light outside. The scene is painted in a heavy, dark oil style with no visible text, frame or people.

last-wild-barbary-lion-shot.description: A large lion with a dark, heavy mane stands on a snowy rocky outcrop under twisted cedar trees at dusk. Below on the left, a tiny dark silhouette of a figure with a rifle stands on a winding trail. The painting is a painterly oil style with a dim, cloudy sky, and it fills the whole frame with no visible border or text.

falkland-islands-wolf-extinct.description: A reddish-brown, fox-like wild canid with a bushy white-tipped tail stands alert on dark tussock grass under a stormy sky. Behind it, a stone cottage with a fence sits on a bleak moorland, with grazing sheep scattered across the plain. In the right background, a silhouetted figure in a wide-brimmed hat aims a long rifle. The image is an edge-to-edge painting with no visible text, frame or border.

last-heath-hen-booming-ben.description: A dark, barred, grouse-like bird with raised pointed neck tufts and a bright orange inflated air sac on its neck stands on leaf litter in dry brushy scrub. Bare branches frame the scene, a misty flat horizon and a pale orange sunrise sit behind it, and two small metal leg bands are visible. No text, no border; the painting runs edge to edge.

xerces-blue-butterfly-extinct.description: A painted scene of a small blue butterfly with grey-brown spotted underwings resting on a purple lupine flower spike in sandy coastal dunes. Behind it, a hillside of dark old wooden houses with power poles and utility wires gives way to rows of newer houses and a street under an overcast dusk sky. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the square edge to edge.

caribbean-monk-seal-last-sighted.description: A single brown-grey seal lies on a dark, wet sandy shore at the water's edge, its head raised toward the viewer. Behind it, calm-to-choppy dark sea runs to a flat horizon under a heavy, stormy overcast sky with warm light breaking at the lower edge of the clouds. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, in an oil-painting style, with no visible text, frame or people.

caspian-tiger-extinct.description: A painted tiger with orange and black stripes walks left-to-right through dry, tall reeds and grasses in a dim forest, with a patch of light on dark water behind it. Thick trunks and bare branches frame the upper area. The style is an oil-like painting with dramatic low light. No visible text, signature or frame.

javan-tiger-last-recorded.description: A tiger stands in a jungle clearing, body turned three-quarters toward the viewer, head looking back over its shoulder. Dense tropical foliage, large leaves and hanging vines frame it. Behind it, terraced rice-style fields spread across a valley with a thin column of smoke rising in the distance under a dusky, warm sky. The style is a dark, painterly oil look with no visible text, border or frame.

dusky-seaside-sparrow-last-dies.description: A small, streaked brown sparrow with an orange leg band perches on a dry grass stalk inside a wooden enclosure. Behind it is a fine wire-mesh screen, with an overcast, marshy grassland and water under a grey sky. The edges show dark wood posts and a window ledge, all part of the scene. There is no text, and nothing is gory or nude.

golden-toad-last-seen.description: A glowing orange-yellow frog or toad sits on a patch of wet green moss beside a dark, shallow forest stream. Around it are large dark leaves, ferns and tangled roots in a misty, dim rainforest rendered in painterly oil style. No people, no buildings, no visible text or frame.

celia-last-pyrenean-ibex-dies.description: A dark, moody painted scene of a single brown wild goat with curved horns and a leather collar with a bell, standing on snowy rocks at the edge of a steep drop. A large fir tree, its branches weighed with snow, leans over it and a fallen trunk lies on the slope to the right. Behind is a misty mountain valley in grey light. No text, frame or border is visible, and the painting fills the square edge to edge.

baiji-functionally-extinct.description: A painted dusk scene on a murky, rippled river harbour. A grey patrol launch with a railed deck carries about seven people in dark clothing, several with binoculars held to their eyes. Cargo barges, tugs, cranes and smokestacks with smoke fill the background under a pale sun. Beneath the water in the lower foreground, a pale long-beaked river dolphin glides as a faint shadow. No text, frame or border is visible.

lonesome-george-dies.description: A large tortoise with a domed, weathered shell and a long wrinkled neck stretches its head upward while walking on dark volcanic ground. Behind it are prickly pear cacti, dark rocks and a still, dark pool. The painting is dark, oil-like and full-bleed, with no visible text, frame or people.

ivory-billed-woodpecker-proposed-extinct.description: A black-and-white woodpecker with a red crest and a long pale bill clings to a rough, peeling dead tree trunk. Behind it, a dark swamp with hanging moss, bare branches and still water. The style is a dim oil painting, with no visible text, frame or people.

chinese-paddlefish-declared-extinct.description: A large grey-silver fish with a long, flat, sword-like snout and a bony, shark-like tail swims diagonally through dark, murky green-grey water. Loose painterly brushstrokes and faint specks of light fill the background. The painting runs edge to edge with no visible text, frame or border.
